subject: Implementation sync: telemetry mapping & runbook adoption (CloudVista)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Vargas <sofia@cloudvista.com>, ops-eng@cloudvista.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation sync: telemetry mapping & runbook adoption (CloudVista)

Hi Sofia and team,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier this week. Per our conversation, I want to lock in a compact implementation plan so we can hit your M1 availability target. Proposed agenda for the initial technical sessions (2x 60m):

- Session A (day 1): Dashboard templates + alert routing (owners: Jordan, Monica)
- Session B (day 3): Tracing hooks, KV/prefix caching instrumentation, and runbook handoff (owner: Priyom)

Attached: obs_runbook_template.md (runbook skeleton), telemetry-mapping-cloudvista.csv (initial field mapping), dashboard-template-v1.json (Grafana seed).

Asks before Session A:
- Can you confirm which teams will attend (SRE, App Instrumentation, Oncall)?
- Do you have any existing alert routing naming conventions we should inherit?
- Retention/PII constraint note: you flagged 180d for logs in the kickoff — please confirm.

Acceptance criteria for the onboarding milestone (M1):
- 3 baseline dashboards deployed to your Grafana org (latency, error taxonomy, request distribution)
- Tracing hooks instrumented for the 3 critical services and visible in our trace UI
- Alert routing mapped to your pager rotations and a documented runbook with handoff sign-off

Proposed timeline: Session A next Tue (Oct 24) or Wed (Oct 25) — which works best?

I'll create a JIRA ticket (SUP-4821) and a Drive folder to house artifacts.

Thanks,

--
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Sofia Vargas <sofia@cloudvista.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation sync: telemetry mapping & runbook adoption (CloudVista)

Mina — thanks, this looks good. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Attendees: SRE (lead: Alejandro), App Instrumentation (lead: Nina), and one oncall rotation engineer. I'll confirm exact names by Monday.
- Alerts: we have a naming convention that prefixes team/service, then severity (e.g., appx-orders-P1). We'll share the conventions as a short doc.
- Retention: confirmed — logs 180 days, traces 30 days, metrics 400 days. Let us know if any of those constraints block ingestion.

Two practical asks: 
1) Can you split the sessions so Session A focuses strictly on dashboards + alert taxonomy? We prefer a smaller scope first.
2) We have a compliance question: will the runbook document contain any PHI or customer-identifying data? Our security team requests confirmation.

We prefer Tue Oct 24 for Session A (10:00–11:00 PT). Session B can be Thu Oct 26 (11:00–12:00 PT).

On the acceptance criteria — we'll want an exportable runbook (markdown) and a short smoke test that our oncall can run.

Thanks,

--
Sofia Vargas
Director, Site Reliability | CloudVista
sofia@cloudvista.com

Date: Mon, 22 Oct 2028 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation sync: telemetry mapping & runbook adoption (CloudVista)

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Sofia — confirmed on the dates. A few firm items and owner-level action items before Session A (Tue Oct 24 10:00 PT):

Action items (owners):
- Jordan Blake: populate dashboard-template-v1.json with panels for latency p50/p95, error-class heatmap, and request distribution. Share Grafana import link by Mon 23 EOD.
- Monica Patel: draft alert-routing matrix (CSV) mapping alert -> team -> pager -> runbook section. Draft due Mon 23 EOD.
- Priyom Das: validate the telemetry-mapping-cloudvista.csv for field name collisions and confirm sampling/tracing config; flag anything that may increase token size for prefix caching.
- Mina Haddad: produce the runbook skeleton and a 1-page smoke test for oncall.

Compliance note: runbook template will be sanitized. We will not include PHI or customer PII in the shared drive artifacts. If any customer logs are referenced, they will be redacted and a secure link (customer-managed) can be used. I'll loop Security if we need an additional attestation.

JIRA: I've created SUP-4821 and added the sprint checklist. Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-cloudvista-onboarding

Acceptance criteria (reiterated):
- Dashboards live in CloudVista Grafana org and importable JSON is available.
- Alerts wired into your routing matrix with runbook references.
- Traces visible and a sampling plan documented.

Let us know if the owners need help pre-populating anything — Jordan/Monica/Priyom please ack.

--
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sofia Vargas <sofia@cloudvista.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Oct 2028 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation sync: telemetry mapping & runbook adoption (CloudVista)

Ack — Ill take the dashboard templates. Quick notes:
- I'll add panels for p50/p95 latency, per-endpoint error rate, a grouped error taxonomy panel (5 buckets), and a synthetic latency test.
- Draft Grafana import link: https://grafana.com/dashboards/draft-cloudvista-seed (placeholder)
- I'll include small query examples (PromQL) and note required metric names so we can reconcile with telemetry-mapping-cloudvista.csv.

If Monica has the routing matrix CSV early, I can wire example alert rules to it in the template.

-Jordan
